name: Scarlet Hollow: Episode 4
storyline: Tabitha got her hands full with the unfolding miners strike. You spend some time unsuccessfully searching for Stella with Kaneeka and after that you have a suspicious meeting with Sybil over a cup of tea. The moment you remember about the supernatural force in the clinic you rush in there. After breaking in you meet up with Reese and you're trying to reach the source together. At first nothing scary happens but your accomplice acts kind of weird after locking you in with himself in the basement.
summary: Stella is missing after she run off last night. Kaneeka suggests go looking for her. Her mom Sybil wants to meet you in the afternoon to discuss something about the mistery and the clinic is still supernaturally attracting you.
